judgement.reason: HedgeDoc 2 consists of separate backend and frontend servers built from different images that must run together behind a proxy, and Deployz runs only one web service per deployment.

evidence.quote: HedgeDoc 2 will be split in two components. The backend and the frontend. Both are present in this repository.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported architecture: docker/docker-compose.yml defines 2 application services (backend, frontend). Deployz runs ONE web process per deployment plus declared background workers.
reviews.reason: HedgeDoc 2 production needs both a backend and a separate frontend image behind a proxy, and nothing shown proves the frontend is optional, so the multi-service finding holds.
